title: The Road to Seoul
story:
By 2010, Jung Hoseok had already spent years developing his skills as a dancer in Gwangju. But he was ready for a new challenge — one that would take him far beyond his hometown.

In the spring of 2010, he auditioned for Big Hit Entertainment. His dance skills and potential caught the company's attention, and he passed the audition. In April 2010, he signed with Big Hit as a trainee, becoming the first of the future BTS members to sign a contract with the company.

However, becoming a trainee did not mean that he immediately left Gwangju. For a while, he continued living in his hometown and received training there through an arrangement with the company. He was able to continue his studies while preparing for the next stage of his journey. His family supported him throughout this period, something j-hope later expressed deep gratitude for.

Then came a life-changing day: December 24, 2010.

On Christmas Eve, Hoseok moved to Seoul to begin living and training with the other members of the team. He later recalled arriving at the dorm and finding it messy and far from the neat, organized place he had imagined. His first task was simple but memorable: cleaning up the space where his new life would begin.

The move meant leaving behind his family, friends, and familiar surroundings. It also meant stepping into a completely different world. Until then, dance had been the center of his life. Now he had to adapt to the demands of becoming an idol, including learning skills that were new to him.

At first, freestyle rap was unfamiliar territory. But Hoseok worked hard, learned from the other trainees, and challenged himself to grow beyond the dancer he had always been.

The boy who had started his journey in Gwangju was now in Seoul, taking his first steps toward a future none of them could fully imagine.

 The road to BTS had begun.
surpriseDescription: Every great journey begins with a brave step. Discover j-hope's memories of moving from Gwangju to Seoul in December 2010 to pursue his dreams.

challenge.question: When did j-hope move to Seoul to live with the other trainees?
challenge.explanation: j-hope signed with Big Hit in April 2010, but continued receiving training in Gwangju for a while. He moved to Seoul on December 24, 2010, Christmas Eve.
